findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker can inject malicious input that, when converted to an integer, triggers unexpected behavior.
findings.assumptions: The code does not explicitly call any command interpreter, but the use of atoi without validation could potentially lead to unexpected behavior if the input is manipulated.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow

findings.assumptions: The code does not handle cases where the input exceeds the buffer size of 256 characters, including the null terminator.
